name: packaging-config
deprecation_criterion: Superseded when the framework adopts a different distribution channel than a self-hosted Claude Code plugin marketplace, or when later slices fold this into a full configure/run UX feature.
spec_change_reason: Cut release v0.36.0 (minor, ASSET-REFRESH — operator-in-control 'config is the bound' guidance): bump _PLUGIN_VERSION 0.35.1 -> 0.36.0 and regenerate the committed plugin tree so the shipped skills/{start,tick}/SKILL.md (re-collected from scheduling 0.51.0's ship/, now start v0.5.0 + tick v0.8.0) carry the 'Limits are operator-owned: config is the bound' guidance, and the shipped hooks/session-start-persona.py (v0.6.0) carries the same principle: the loop's limits are operator-owned via configuration (budget/backoff/issue_filter/mode) and enforced by the deterministic runner; the executor invents no ad-hoc token/tick/issue caps nor silently narrows scope, keeps draining while a tick reports refire, and surfaces genuine anomalies to the operator (who bounds via /auto-maintainer:configure or halts via /auto-maintainer:stop). No _LIBS change and no shipped default-config CONTENT change (schema unchanged); the committed lib/ digest is byte-identical to 0.35.1; no shipped-agent change. The version-assertion test advanced to 0.36.0, e2e tests added asserting the shipped persona hook carries the operator-in-control principle and the shipped start/tick skills carry the operator-owned guidance, the two skill-version assertions advanced (start 0.4.0 -> 0.5.0, tick 0.7.0 -> 0.8.0), test/release_lib_baseline.json re-anchored (version -> 0.36.0, lib_digest unchanged), and the housekeep doc baseline re-anchored to the grown spec (491 -> 506) so the drift, #355 monotonicity, and doc-size guards stay green.
spec_no_change_reason: Spec already updated with the Plugin minor v0.36.0 section in commit 2590e0c; this cycle carries the asset-refresh build regen (persona hook edit + _PLUGIN_VERSION bump + tree regenerate) and test/baseline re-anchor only.
